Man i thought i was playing Dark Souls, but every hit is instant death.
Then i realized, the damn game started on the DLC [u]The Dark Horizon[/u], instead of the base game, i was playing with enemies i was not even supposed to, no wonder i was dying so much on 1 hit, had to uninstall out of frustation, but installed again after noticing that.
Now i can finally walk without exploding every second.
The game is super fun, but SOLO is definitely not it, it gets tedious fast and you can get easily overrun by enemies, even if they are weak they take a huge chunk of health as it gets impossible to dodge, and speaking of the demon, the dodge is awful in this game, it does absolutely nothing, its like when Spider-man did that flip to dodge Green goblins grab, but handed up being grabed anyway.
No more armor upgrade apparently, if you want better stats, either you find a new armor or use relics, and the game hides alot of content from you, i get it it that the Developers want people to explore, but Dear lord, important items should not be in secret places.
Everything good that was in the first was completly forgotten, while the features we hated was implemented on this one.

A few things that i´m enjoying th, is the guns, the guns in this game are amazing, and the abilities are also very good, the level atmosphere is suberb too, but the game quickly reminds of the negative things i meantioned above.
Don´t get me wrong, i love this game, but it needs a few changes.
Great game, would 1v1 a boss while my friends scream at me to run again

Just wanted a fun co-op game to play. Could count the weapons we found on captain hook's bad hand but Literally had rings for days. Love the look and feel of the game, But its just not fun dying in 2 or 3 hits from EVERYTHING. Enemies are way over-tuned, Not much enjoyment to be found. £14 was worth it, But full price I would've cried like a baby. Update tried again. Awful game. £14, I would've rather eaten the money. Honestly. Awful.

Really solid game overall.

Gameplay feels great — one of the best third-person shooters I’ve played. Combat is smooth, responsive, and fun whether you’re solo or in co-op.

The fragment/gearing system is decent but could use better explanations. Some parts aren’t very clear at first, especially if you’re new to it.

Lore and world-building are top-notch. The game doesn’t tell you everything — it lets the worlds and environments tell the story instead, and it works really well.

Difficulty is fair and manageable. Not overly hard, but still keeps things interesting.

Overall, an excellent game that’s worth playing. Highly recommended for those that want to try a shooter and enjoy different combination of play styles.

It is still a poor game after 2 years from release.

And a special thanks to the people responsible for the decision to hide all the equipment behind super obscure quests or puzzles. It is so nice to find 3 guns after 40 hours of a gameplay (1 from story quest, 1 is my luck I supose and 1 is because I got super annoyed and checked the guide). The whole game seems to be built on this foundation:
- want new guns? Check the guide, restart levels to random a needed map layout, which contains related puzzle
- want new traits? Check the guide, restart levels to random a needed map layout, which contains related puzzle
- want new rings? Well, yeah, you got it

Haven't been annoyed by the game so much for a long time
